# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Hand-maintained reusable workflows that are neither a facade nor generated,
# read by tests/python/test_reusable_variant_sources.py (#1356).
#
# A `reusable-*.yml` in .github/workflows is one of three things:
#   - a facade: it declares `# lgtm-ci-readonly-variant:` or
#     `# lgtm-ci-overlay-variant:` and is the hand-edited source of its
#     variants;
#   - generated: its first line is the `# GENERATED by
#     scripts/ci/workflows/sync-readonly-variants.sh` header;
#   - standalone: listed below, one file name per line, sorted.
#
# A standalone file shares no job graph with another reusable. A new reusable
# that copies most of an existing one does not belong here: make it a variant
# of that facade (docs/reusable-workflows.md "Overlay variants") or fold it
# behind an input. The near-copies reusable-release-multi-ecosystem.yml
# (#1587) and reusable-test-node-custom.yml (#1356) were removed or generated
# that way and must never be listed again. An entry whose file is gone, or
# which is now a facade or generated, fails the test until it is deleted.
